items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: He was playing with Allen, too. He was one of the fellas playing with Allen at that time.

ctx.x: No, there isn't. You know all them Creole people, all them funny names. I just don't mean nothing. Not that I know of. I know his people. They had plenty of fellas out there. Old musicians, you see. They were... I was living in the country then. Mm-hmm. The time I'm telling you what, when they come out there. And when I come here, well, they had done this band.
You remember Frankie Doosen ever went down in the country that way? Did you work with him?
He was playing with Allen, too. He was one of the fellas playing with Allen at that time.
